features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: AMP home loans allow for flexible additional repayments to reduce interest and pay off loans faster. features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: AMP Bank home loans allow eligible applicants to use a guarantor, typically a close family member who provides additional security for the loan. features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Redraw applies to AMP Bank variable rate home loans only. You can access extra funds you’ve deposited at any time, with no withdrawal fees when using online banking, the AMP app, BankPhone or BankAssist. Minimum amounts and daily limits may apply.

features.label: OFFSET
features.info: You can choose to set up an Offset Deposit Account on a variable rate loan. A $6 monthly account management fee is payable on the Offset Deposit Account when linked to a Basic Variable Rate Loan.

features.label: CARD_ACCESS
features.info: A card is available for the product to access funds

features.label: UNLIMITED_TXNS
features.info: Service fees may apply for manual redraw requests or special services.

features.label: DIGITAL_WALLET
features.value: Apple Pay, Samsung Pay or Google Pay
features.info: Customers can link eligible AMP accounts to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay for secure and convenient digital wallet transactions.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Customers can access and manage their home loan online via My AMP, our secure digital banking platform, offering features for easy account monitoring and transactions.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Construction available for up to a 12 month interest only period

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: AMP home loans allow for flexible additional repayments to reduce interest and pay off loans faster. Variable rate loans allow unlimited extra repayments, while fixed-rate loans often limit these to $10,000 per 12-month period. Please refer to Loan Conditions and Credit guide for more information on the consequences of repaying your Fixed Rate Loan early

features.label: ADDITIONAL_CARDS
features.info: Additional cards can be requested.

features.label: FRAUD_PROTECTION
features.info: AMP home loans are protected by secure login, encryption, transaction monitoring, and customer alerts to help prevent and detect fraud. Support is available for customers in the event of suspected unauthorised activity.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: AMP Bank home loans allow eligible applicants to use a guarantor, typically a close family member who provides additional security for the loan. This can help customers who have a limited deposit or may not meet standard lending criteria. Guarantor eligibility is subject to AMP Bank’s lending requirements and the guarantor’s financial position.

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT

constraints.label: OTHER

ANZ|3a86f9e4-1b41-4222-9091-5934d1fc9178.description: Our fixed rate home loan gives you the certainty of knowing what your repayments will be during the fixed period. ANZ Fixed Home Loans are available for periods between of at least 1 year and up to 30 years in duration.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Loan Approval Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee in respect to the establishment of your new loan/facility. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation Administration Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Valuation Administration Fee for any valuations we undertake on properties relating to the establishment of your loan/facility. Refer to the ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Guarantee Administration Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Guarantee Administration Fee where a guarantee is taken by us for the purpose of securing your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Loan Administration Charge
fees.info: We will not charge a monthly Loan Administration Charge for your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Non Credit Critical)
fees.info: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.info: Charged when a payment remains unpaid for 30 days or more after it is due. A further fee is payable monthly when the loan continues to be in arrears. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Lock Rate Fee
fees.info: This fee is payable if you'd like to lock in the interest rate at the time of your application for up to 90 days. The Lock Rate fee will be $750 for every $1M of lending. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Lodgement Fee
fees.info: Payable for each document that ANZ lodges or registers with any person or authority in respect of your loan or any security provided for your loan, where ANZ is required or entitled to lodge or register that document. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: Payable for each Certificate or Title or other security document ANZ produces at your request, in connection with your loan. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Fee
fees.info: Payable each time that ANZ is required to attend a settlement (or attend to an electronic settlement) in relation to any advance made under your Loan, or in relation to any securities provided or varied in respect of your Loan. The fee is payable on the date of the settlement and is not dependent on the settlement being successful. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Search Fee
fees.info: Payable each time that ANZ obtains information from governmental or regulatory records in connection with the loan/facility or any security. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Full Credit Critical)
fees.info: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Progress Payment fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Progress Payment Fee for any progressively drawn loans. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Early Repayment Cost
fees.info: You may have to pay this if you pay your loan off in full, make an early or extra repayment, or make certain other changes to your loan, during any fixed-rate period. This is calculated specifically related to the individual event. More details and method of calculation are given in the ANZ Consumer Lending Terms and Conditions booklet under the heading 'Repaying your loan early or making other changes to your loan during a fixed interest rate period'. This booklet can be found on anz.com.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance
fees.info: Lenders Mortgage Insurance protects your lender in the event that you default on your home loan and there is a 'shortfall'. A shortfall happens when the proceeds from the sale of your home are not enough to cover the outstanding amount you owe to your lender. If your loan with ANZ requires LMI, ANZ will arrange it and will tell you the cost of the premium and any additional information that may be required. You may also be charged stamp duty, depending on the State or Territory where the security property for your loan is located.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Mortgage Document
fees.info: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Transfer Land
fees.info: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Enforcement expenses
fees.info: Expenses payable in the event of default. You will be required to pay expenses reasonably incurred by ANZ in enforcing or preserving its rights under your agreement or any security interest provided to ANZ in connection with your agreement. These expenses include those incurred by ANZ in preserving or maintaining property secured, collection expenses and expenses resulting from dishonour of a cheque or payment. Enforcement expenses may be debited in the same way as other fees and charges.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Other Services
fees.info: If we deal with, vary or supplement our security documentation to comply with your requirements, we may charge a fee. An estimate of the fee can be provided once your specific requirements have been ascertained. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Registration of Mortgage
fees.info: Payable to the government body when registering a mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Discharge of Mortgage
fees.info: Payable to the government body when discharging an existing mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

features.label: OFFSET
features.info: With an ANZ One offset account, you could offset the amount you owe on your one-year fixed rate home loan and you'll only be charged interest on the difference.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Not available during fixed rate period. Once your loan reverts to the Standard Variable Rate, the redraw option may be available to allow you access to additional repayments you may have made to your loan.

features.label: CASHBACK_OFFER
features.info: If you're buying your first home, you could get $3,000 to spend however you like, plus support from an ANZ First Home Coach. Available to eligible first home buyers with an ANZ home loan of $250,000 or more. Drawdown within 180 days of applying, bonus paid after settlement. Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: You can make extra repayments up to a set available tolerance amount (the lesser of 5% of the loan amount at the start of the fixed rate period or $5,000) in each year of the fixed rate period. If the total fixed rate period is less than a year, the tolerance amount is reduced proportionally. If you choose to make additional repayments above this tolerance amount, repay your fixed rate loan (in part or in full), with our consent, or switch to a new fixed interest rate or variable interest rate before the end of your fixed rate period, change the term of the current fixed interest rate period of your loan or change certain terms of your loan, you may have to pay an early repayment cost.

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: You must be 18 years of age or older to apply

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: Australian citizens, New Zealand citizens or Australian permanent residents

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: Applicant's primary income is in Australian Dollars

fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance Premium
fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

CommBank|4d414eebcc794010b95a94e4e9e3480.description: An investment home loan where the interest rate is fixed for 1 year.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Rate Lock Fee
fees.info: $750 per Rate Lock. Payable if you elect to lock in your interest rates and is charged when we set up your home loan or when your rate lock request is processed (if requested later). This non-refundable fee applies to 1-5 Year Fixed Rate home loans only. We will lock in the interest rates from when we receive your completed rate lock form and will end 90 days after we process your rate lock request. Fee applies per rate lock.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Fee
fees.info: $150 if the disclosure date in the contract is before 03/02/12. Payable regardless of whether we attend settlement or not, when the Bank or our representatives, arranges the funding of the loan.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Cheque Fee
fees.info: Payable if you require additional cheques (more than two) to fund / settle the loan. Fee applied per cheque.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.info: For home loans - If your account falls into arrears, you will be charged a late payment fee. This fee is payable on the fifth business day after the monthly repayment due date. We will continue to charge the fee monthly until you repay all arrears or you enter into an arrangement with us for the full repayment of those arrears (even if you repay your loan weekly or fortnightly). If you break that arrangement the fee will continue to apply.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Fee (Discharge)
fees.info: Payable if you discharge the loan, i.e. either sell part or all of the Security Property or refinance your Loan with another credit provider.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Administrative Fee
fees.info: An Administrative fee is payable if you repay your home loan in full before the fixed interest rate period expires; or make partial prepayments which exceed $10,000 in any year of your fixed rate loan.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Early Repayment Adjustment Fee
fees.info: An Early Repayment Adjustment is payable if you make partial prepayments on a fixed rate loan which exceed $10,000 in any year of your fixed rate loan (including paying the loan off in full); or make full prepayment during a capped or one-year guaranteed rate period of a home loan; or switch your Fixed Rate loan before the selected fixed or guaranteed rate period expires; or Top up the amount of credit of a home loan during a fixed or guaranteed rate period.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Additional Security Fee
fees.info: Payable if we require you to provide more than one security (i.e. the security used to support the repayment of the loan), and one or more of these securities is 'new' i.e. does not already secure another loan. Fee is applied per 'new' security.

fees.label: VARIATION
fees.name: Periodical Payments or Transfers
fees.info: $1.80 plus transfer fee, bank cheque fee and postage as applicable. Payable if you arrange a periodical payment or ask us to transfer funds.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Security Guarantee Fee
fees.info: Payable if a guarantor is listed on the loan schedule. Fee is applied per borrower.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Security Substitution Fee
fees.info: Payable if you ask us to substitute one of your securities with another.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Stop Payment Notice Fee
fees.info: Payable if you ask us to stop payment on a cheque you have written. Fee is applied per request.

fees.label: ENQUIRY
fees.name: Voucher Fee
fees.info: Payable if you ask us to retrieve a voucher (i.e. deposit, credit or debit slips) that records a transaction on the Loan Account. $4 per voucher (minimum charge $12) or $60 per hour spent to retrieve voucher(s).

fees.label: ENQUIRY
fees.name: Trust Investigation Fee and UTC Clause 2.1e
fees.info: To be advised when we calculate the fee. Payable if we incur investigation cost for loans involving a Trust. This fee applies even if we don't give you a loan. (Refer to UTC Clause 2.1)

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Home Loan Package Fee
fees.info: The fee is charged annually to your nominated account when your home loan has package benefits included under the Wealth Package (non-broker customers only) or Mortgage Advantage (broker customers only).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Lenders' Mortgage Insurance/Low Deposit Premium
fees.info: Lenders' Mortgage Insurance (LMI) or Low Deposit Premium (LDP) may apply where there is an increased risk associated with a home loan. The circumstances of your loan determine whether a loan will incur LMI or LDP. They are a one-off cost added to the total loan amount. The LMI premium is passed on to you and is not an establishment fee. The LDP is a bank fee and not an establishment fee.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Annual Service Fee
fees.info: Payable if your home loan is with the former State Bank of Victoria and the terms and conditions state the fee is required.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Fixed Rates are subject to change up until funding. 'Rate Lock' is an optional feature that allows you to lock in your reference interest rates on new Fixed Rate Home Loan and Fixed Rate Investment Home Loan applications for 90 days for a non-refundable fee, charged per fixed rate loan account. This excludes Home Seeker applications, CommBank Green Loan applications, switching, splitting, top-ups, loan purpose transfers or repayment changes. Rate Lock can be requested any time before loan documents are issued and the reference interest rates applicable to your Rate Lock will be on the date we receive the completed Rate Lock consent from all applicants. The Rate Lock fee will be debited from your Related Account when the Rate Lock request is processed. If there are insufficient funds in that account, or the account is no longer open, then the Rate Lock fee will be charged to your home loan and your home loan will go into arrears (and fees may be charged). The 90 days commences when the Rate Lock request is processed. You can ask us to break the Rate Lock before funding (for example, if rates go down) and revert to the reference interest rates available on the funding date.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: You can make additional repayments of up to $10,000 for each year of your fixed rate loan, without incurring additional charges. Excluding Interest in advance periods. Administrative Fee and an Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) may apply. See the 'Additional repayments' section in the Fixed Rate Home Loan fact sheet for more details.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Redraw is not available during a fixed rate period. However, if you do make additional repayments during a fixed rate period, or had available redraw when you entered your fixed rate period, the redraw feature will become available at the expiry of the fixed rate. The amount available is adjusted so that at the end of your agreed loan term, both your loan balance and the available redraw will be zero.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Through a top up you can borrow an additional $10,000 or more - subject to equity held in your property and our approval. However it's important to know that a top up would break your fixed rate contract and Administrative Fee and an Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) may apply. Please contact us to discuss this. They are not permitted during the Interest in Advance period.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Switching is a change to one or more aspects of your loan's terms and conditions, for example switching from a variable rate to a fixed rate or switching from Interest Only payments to Principal and Interest repayments. You may be charged an Administrative Fee and Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) if you switch out of your fixed rate loan.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Splitting is when you divide one loan into two or more loan accounts, generally with different loan types, repayment types or interest rates. You may be charged an Administrative Fee and Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) if you split your fixed rate loan.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Enjoy home loan interest rate discounts, and waivers on certain fees (subject to eligibility criteria). To receive these benefits your home loan must be receiving Package benefits under the Wealth Package (non-broker customers only) or Mortgage Advantage (broker customers only).

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who agrees to be responsible for repaying a debt owed to us under a loan provided to another individual or business if the borrower (or borrowers) cannot make their repayments. A guarantor supports the loan by providing us with an additional security such as their home. By providing a guarantee, we may lend to the borrower in situations where they may not have been able to secure the full amount of the loan they require.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan can be used for the purposes of investment property purchases, refinancing your existing home loan, purchasing of vacant land (non-commercial) and personal needs (e.g.home renovations, consolidation of personal debt and personal investments).

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan cannot be used for business purposes, bridging loans, off the plan purchases and building/construction purposes

features.label: OTHER
features.info: If you have a Fixed Rate Investment Home Loan with Interest Only payments, you can pay Interest 12 months in advance and there is only one interest rate option, being Interest Only rate less a 0.20% p.a. discount.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: At Maturity of the fixed term, the Fixed Rate Home loan will switch to SVR Investment Home loan and the interest rate will revert to the SVR Rate applicable to your loan and repayment type.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: 1-30 years

eligibility.label: BUSINESS
eligibility.info: Non-trading Companies and/or Family/Unit/Hybrid Trusts.

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: Individuals (natural persons, including as Trustee of a Family Trust) must have the legal capacity to enter into the loan contract, provide acceptable identification documentation and be 18 years or older.

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: Applications for home loans are subject to the Bank's normal credit approval.

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: CITIZEN, PERMANENT_RESIDENT
eligibility.info: Individuals must either be living in Australia as an Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen, Australian permanent resident or specified temporary Australian resident; or be an overseas citizen co-borrowing with an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident or be living overseas as an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident.

constraints.label: OPENING_BALANCE
constraints.info: For a Fixed Rate Loan, there is a minimum loan amount of $10,000 for new loans.

constraints.label: MAX_LVR
constraints.info: The total LVR for an existing and/or new Fixed Rate Home Loan cannot exceed 95% (subject to any postcode restrictions)

Rate Lock can be requested any time before loan documents are issued and the reference interest rates applicable to your Rate Lock will be on the date we receive the completed Rate Lock consent from all applicants. The Rate Lock fee will be debited from your Related Account when the Rate Lock request is processed. If there are insufficient funds in that account, or the account is no longer open, then the Rate Lock fee will be charged to your home loan and your home loan will go into arrears (and fees may be charged). The 90 days commences when the Rate Lock request is processed. You can ask us to break the Rate Lock before funding (for example, if rates go down) and revert to the reference interest rates available on the funding date.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Fixed Rates are subject to change up until funding. 'Rate Lock' is an optional feature that allows you to lock in your reference interest rates on new Fixed Rate Home Loan and Fixed Rate Investment Home Loan applications for 90 days for a non-refundable fee, charged per fixed rate loan account. This excludes Home Seeker applications, CommBank Green Loan applications, switching, splitting, top-ups, loan purpose transfers or repayment changes. Rate Lock can be requested any time before loan documents are issued and the reference interest rates applicable to your Rate Lock will be on the date we receive the completed Rate Lock consent from all applicants. The Rate Lock fee will be debited from your Related Account when the Rate Lock request is processed. If there are insufficient funds in that account, or the account is no longer open, then the Rate Lock fee will be charged to your home loan and your home loan will go into arrears (and fees may be charged). The 90 days commences when the Rate Lock request is processed. You can ask us to break the Rate Lock before funding (for example, if rates go down) and revert to the reference interest rates available on the funding date.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: You can make additional repayments of up to $10,000 for each year of your fixed rate loan, without incurring additional charges. Excluding Interest in advance periods. Administrative Fee and an Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) may apply. See the 'Additional repayments' section in the Fixed Rate Home Loan fact sheet for more details.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Redraw is not available during a fixed rate period. However, if you do make additional repayments during a fixed rate period, or had available redraw when you entered your fixed rate period, the redraw feature will become available at the expiry of the fixed rate. The amount available is adjusted so that at the end of your agreed loan term, both your loan balance and the available redraw will be zero.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Through a top up you can borrow an additional $10,000 or more - subject to equity held in your property and our approval. However it's important to know that a top up would break your fixed rate contract and Administrative Fee and an Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) may apply. Please contact us to discuss this. They are not permitted during the Interest in Advance period.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Switching is a change to one or more aspects of your loan's terms and conditions, for example switching from a variable rate to a fixed rate or switching from Interest Only payments to Principal and Interest repayments. You may be charged an Administrative Fee and Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) if you switch out of your fixed rate loan.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Splitting is when you divide one loan into two or more loan accounts, generally with different loan types, repayment types or interest rates. You may be charged an Administrative Fee and Early Repayment Adjustment (ERA) if you split your fixed rate loan.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Enjoy home loan interest rate discounts, and waivers on certain fees (subject to eligibility criteria). To receive these benefits your home loan must be receiving Package benefits under the Wealth Package (non-broker customers only) or Mortgage Advantage (broker customers only).

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who agrees to be responsible for repaying a debt owed to us under a loan provided to another individual or business if the borrower (or borrowers) cannot make their repayments. A guarantor supports the loan by providing us with an additional security such as their home. By providing a guarantee, we may lend to the borrower in situations where they may not have been able to secure the full amount of the loan they require.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan can be used for the purposes of investment property purchases, refinancing your existing home loan, purchasing of vacant land (non-commercial) and personal needs (e.g.home renovations, consolidation of personal debt and personal investments).

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan cannot be used for business purposes, bridging loans, off the plan purchases and building/construction purposes

features.label: OTHER
features.info: If you have a Fixed Rate Investment Home Loan with Interest Only payments, you can pay Interest 12 months in advance and there is only one interest rate option, being Interest Only rate less a 0.20% p.a. discount.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: At Maturity of the fixed term, the Fixed Rate Home loan will switch to SVR Investment Home loan and the interest rate will revert to the SVR Rate applicable to your loan and repayment type.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: 1-30 years

eligibility.label: NATURAL_PERSON
eligibility.info: Available to Individuals.

eligibility.label: BUSINESS
eligibility.info: Non-trading Companies and/or Family/Unit/Hybrid Trusts.

eligibility.label: OTHER

This gives you the flexibility to structure your home loan to suit your individual needs by choosing the loan amount, loan type, loan term and repayment structure for each loan.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Enjoy home loan interest rate discounts, and waivers on certain fees (subject to eligibility criteria). To receive these benefits your home loan must be receiving Package benefits under the Wealth Package (non-broker customers only) or Mortgage Advantage (broker customers only).

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: Additional repayments can be made at any time. No fees apply.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who agrees to be responsible for repaying a debt owed to us under a loan provided to another individual or business, if the borrower(s) can't make their repayments. A guarantor supports the loan by providing us with additional security such as a property they own. By providing a guarantee, we may lend to the borrower in situations where they may not have been able to secure the full amount on their own.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan can be used for the purposes of owner occupied property purchases, refinancing your existing home loan, purchasing of vacant land (non-commercial), personal needs (e.g. home renovations, consolidation of personal debt, personal investments), off the plan purchases, bridging loan and building/construction purposes.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan cannot be used for business purposes

features.label: OTHER
features.info: 1-30 years (Subject to our approval)

eligibility.label: BUSINESS
eligibility.info: Non-trading Companies and/or Family/Unit/Hybrid Trusts.

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: Individuals (natural persons, including as Trustee of a Family Trust) must have the legal capacity to enter into the loan contract, provide acceptable identification documentation and be 18 years or older.

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: Applications for home loans are subject to the Bank's normal credit approval.

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: CITIZEN, PERMANENT_RESIDENT
eligibility.info: Individuals must either be living in Australia as an Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen, Australian permanent resident or specified temporary Australian resident; or be an overseas citizen co-borrowing with an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident or be living overseas as an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident.

constraints.label: OPENING_BALANCE
constraints.info: Minimum loan $10,000 - subject to your loan purpose, equity in your property and our approval

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Depending on your circumstances and loan purpose, a minimum post bridging debt of $250,000 may apply

constraints.label: MAX_LVR
constraints.info: The total LVR for an existing and/or new Standard Variable Rate Home Loan cannot exceed 95% (subject to any postcode restrictions)

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Break cost fee
fees.info: Payable before expiry of any period when interest rate is fixed on any portion of loan due to loan being repaid, interest becoming variable or default. We calculate the ‘break cost’ using the following formula: Let n = the remaining number of months for which the rate is fixed. Let A = current outstandings. Let P = monthly scheduled payments. Let z = annual fixed interest rate payable monthly. Let y = annual reinvestment rate payable monthly. Let b = (1+y/12)n Let d = (1+z/12)n. Then the Break Value is given by: (A/b)*(d-b)+12P/(byz)*(z(b-1)-y(d-1)).

Great Southern Bank|4400-7102|RESIDENTIA.description: Lock in your interest rate for 1, 2, 3 or 5 years with our fixed rate home loan and know what your repayments will be. Plus, pay off your loan sooner with free extra repayments.

fees.label: UPFRONT_PER_PLAN
fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.info: An establishment fee applies to all credit facilities and includes the cost of processing the application and the preparation of the Great Southern Bank loan documentation.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Telegraphic transfer fee within Australia
fees.info: Local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia. Payable where you request a local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Account Information Fee
fees.info: Account informaton fee is payable when customer request the following: - An annual audit certificate on a Great Southern Bank account - A copy of a cheque or Visa voucher - Personal information, traces, document copies (other than those specified above) and/or information pertaining to an account Where further investigation is required an additional hourly rate of $20 per hour will apply. An estimate of the costs involved will be provided prior to the work being undertaken.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. A valuation fee may be payable in the future if Great Southern Bank considers it necessary to revalue the property at any time. The amount of the fee will be subject to the Great Southern Bank panel valuers scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium
fees.info: Applicable only to eligible loans participating in the Home Guarantee Schemes including the First Home Guarantee (previously know as the First Home Loan Deposit Scheme), New Home Guarantee, Family Home Guarantee or Regional First Home Buyer Guarantee. If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Arrears Letter Fee
fees.info: Payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a letter in relation to arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Default notice fee is payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a default notice in relation to outstanding arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee
fees.info: Split loan fee is payable a split involves two or more separate facilities (accounts). Customers can elect to split their loan facility at time of application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Fixed rate lock fee
fees.info: A Fixed Rate Lock fee is payable to each fixed rate loan where the borrower has requested to have Fixed Rate Lock on their home loan application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Early Payout Cost (EPC)
fees.info: When you enter into a fixed rate loan contract, you are effectively locking in the loan interest rate offered to you for an agreed period of time (e.g. 5 years). If you decide to switch or payout your fixed rate loan before the end of your agreed period, you are effectively breaking that fixed rate loan agreement, an EPC that could cost you thousands of dollars may apply. Please refer to our ‘Early Payout Cost Factsheet’ for more information. Contracts entered into prior to 28 September 2021, the amount is referred to as an Early Payout Fee.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee
fees.info: Costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding debts vary depending on the nature of the default. These costs are applied by the Solicitors or independent contractors engaged to undertake action to recover the funds and are debited to the account that is "out of order".

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Security Adminstration Fee
fees.info: For each security offered to the Great Southern Bank loan. A securities administration fee applies to all secured credit facilities. The securities administration fee represents the average cost based on typical charges incurred in settling loans, including: • Progressive drawdowns • Bank cheque fee • Agent fee • Land title search • Credit reference fee • PPSR searches • PPSR charges

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge Fee
fees.info: If you pay out the loan partially or in full where a discharge of security is required, or you request a discharge of a security, a discharge fee is payable (per release or transaction).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee
fees.info: $200 minimum withdrawal applies in branch.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: If you request a title held by Great Southern Bank to be produced to a relevant state’s land titles office for any purpose, a production fee is payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee
fees.info: A variation fee is payable if you request any changes to the Credit Contract or Security - for example: - Re-arrange and/or substitute a security on a mortgage - Consent to any dealings in relation to property - Switch from one interest rate product to another, at the request of the borrower - Where a fixed interest rate has decreased between loan approval and loan funding, at the request of the borrower.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Government fees and charges
fees.info: Government fees and charges relating to stamp duty and registration are payable on an event causing a change or variation to the transaction and/or security being taken in the applicable state or territory. The amount of the fee will be subject to the relevant government scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Solicitors costs
fees.info: Solicitors costs are payable where they are engaged to prepare documents or provide advice relating to your matter on Great Southern Bank’s behalf.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Enjoy free redraw. Access your additional home loan repayments with redraw, so you can use it whenever you need some breathing space. A $200 minimum withdrawal amount applies for redraws conducted in-branch.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: $0 Monthly or annual fees.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, Great Southern Bank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who promises to repay money that is owed to us under a loan, if for some reason the borrower doesn’t.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: Up to $30,000 in total extra payments permitted during the fixed rate period. A daily transfer will refund any amounts paid in advance in excess of the total advance repayments allowed during the fixed rate period unless sufficient to pay out the loan in full (in which case an Early Payout Cost may apply). Excess funds will be transferred to the nominated deposit account, which must remain open for the fixed rate period.

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: You must be an Australian citizen or Australian resident to hold an account with Great Southern Bank

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: To be 18 or over

eligibility.label: NATURAL_PERSON
eligibility.info: Applications are for individuals and personal use purposes only.

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Fixed Rate loans are available to (a) new home loans with a minimum application amount of $100,000; or (b) switching or restructuring of existing home loans.

constraints.label: MAX_LVR
constraints.info: Max LVR for Investor Home Loan products is 90%

constraints.label: MIN_LVR
constraints.info: Min LVR for Home Loan products is 1%

Great Southern Bank|4200-7102|RESIDENTIA.description: Lock in your interest rate for 1, 2, 3 or 5 years with our fixed rate home loan and know what your repayments will be. Plus, pay off your loan sooner with free extra repayments.

fees.label: UPFRONT_PER_PLAN
fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.info: An establishment fee applies to all credit facilities and includes the cost of processing the application and the preparation of the Great Southern Bank loan documentation.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Telegraphic transfer fee within Australia
fees.info: Local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia. Payable where you request a local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Account Information Fee
fees.info: Account informaton fee is payable when customer request the following: - An annual audit certificate on a Great Southern Bank account - A copy of a cheque or Visa voucher - Personal information, traces, document copies (other than those specified above) and/or information pertaining to an account Where further investigation is required an additional hourly rate of $20 per hour will apply. An estimate of the costs involved will be provided prior to the work being undertaken.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. A valuation fee may be payable in the future if Great Southern Bank considers it necessary to revalue the property at any time. The amount of the fee will be subject to the Great Southern Bank panel valuers scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium
fees.info: Applicable only to eligible loans participating in the Home Guarantee Schemes including the First Home Guarantee (previously know as the First Home Loan Deposit Scheme), New Home Guarantee, Family Home Guarantee or Regional First Home Buyer Guarantee. If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Arrears Letter Fee
fees.info: Payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a letter in relation to arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Default notice fee is payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a default notice in relation to outstanding arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee
fees.info: Split loan fee is payable a split involves two or more separate facilities (accounts). Customers can elect to split their loan facility at time of application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Fixed rate lock fee
fees.info: A Fixed Rate Lock fee is payable to each fixed rate loan where the borrower has requested to have Fixed Rate Lock on their home loan application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Early Payout Cost (EPC)
fees.info: When you enter into a fixed rate loan contract, you are effectively locking in the loan interest rate offered to you for an agreed period of time (e.g. 5 years). If you decide to switch or payout your fixed rate loan before the end of your agreed period, you are effectively breaking that fixed rate loan agreement, an EPC that could cost you thousands of dollars may apply. Please refer to our ‘Early Payout Cost Factsheet’ for more information. Contracts entered into prior to 28 September 2021, the amount is referred to as an Early Payout Fee.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee
fees.info: Costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding debts vary depending on the nature of the default. These costs are applied by the Solicitors or independent contractors engaged to undertake action to recover the funds and are debited to the account that is "out of order".

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Security Adminstration Fee
fees.info: For each security offered to the Great Southern Bank loan. A securities administration fee applies to all secured credit facilities. The securities administration fee represents the average cost based on typical charges incurred in settling loans, including: • Progressive drawdowns • Bank cheque fee • Agent fee • Land title search • Credit reference fee • PPSR searches • PPSR charges

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge Fee
fees.info: If you pay out the loan partially or in full where a discharge of security is required, or you request a discharge of a security, a discharge fee is payable (per release or transaction).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee
fees.info: $200 minimum withdrawal applies in branch.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: If you request a title held by Great Southern Bank to be produced to a relevant state’s land titles office for any purpose, a production fee is payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee
fees.info: A variation fee is payable if you request any changes to the Credit Contract or Security - for example: - Re-arrange and/or substitute a security on a mortgage - Consent to any dealings in relation to property - Switch from one interest rate product to another, at the request of the borrower - Where a fixed interest rate has decreased between loan approval and loan funding, at the request of the borrower.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Government fees and charges
fees.info: Government fees and charges relating to stamp duty and registration are payable on an event causing a change or variation to the transaction and/or security being taken in the applicable state or territory. The amount of the fee will be subject to the relevant government scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Solicitors costs
fees.info: Solicitors costs are payable where they are engaged to prepare documents or provide advice relating to your matter on Great Southern Bank’s behalf.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Enjoy free redraw. Access your additional home loan repayments with redraw, so you can use it whenever you need some breathing space. A $200 minimum withdrawal amount applies for redraws conducted in-branch.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: $0 Monthly or annual fees.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, Great Southern Bank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who promises to repay money that is owed to us under a loan, if for some reason the borrower doesn’t.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: Up to $30,000 in total extra payments permitted during the fixed rate period. A daily transfer will refund any amounts paid in advance in excess of the total advance repayments allowed during the fixed rate period unless sufficient to pay out the loan in full (in which case an Early Payout Cost may apply). Excess funds will be transferred to the nominated deposit account, which must remain open for the fixed rate period.

Great Southern Bank|4200-7302|RESIDENTIA.description: Lock in your interest rate for 1, 2, 3 or 5 years with our fixed rate home loan and know what your repayments will be. Plus, pay off your loan sooner with free extra repayments.

fees.label: UPFRONT_PER_PLAN
fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.info: An establishment fee applies to all credit facilities and includes the cost of processing the application and the preparation of the Great Southern Bank loan documentation.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Telegraphic transfer fee within Australia
fees.info: Local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia. Payable where you request a local telegraphic transfer to an account at a financial institution within Australia.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Account Information Fee
fees.info: Account informaton fee is payable when customer request the following: - An annual audit certificate on a Great Southern Bank account - A copy of a cheque or Visa voucher - Personal information, traces, document copies (other than those specified above) and/or information pertaining to an account Where further investigation is required an additional hourly rate of $20 per hour will apply. An estimate of the costs involved will be provided prior to the work being undertaken.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. A valuation fee may be payable in the future if Great Southern Bank considers it necessary to revalue the property at any time. The amount of the fee will be subject to the Great Southern Bank panel valuers scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium
fees.info: Applicable only to eligible loans participating in the Home Guarantee Schemes including the First Home Guarantee (previously know as the First Home Loan Deposit Scheme), New Home Guarantee, Family Home Guarantee or Regional First Home Buyer Guarantee. If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Arrears Letter Fee
fees.info: Payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a letter in relation to arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Default notice fee is payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a default notice in relation to outstanding arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee
fees.info: Split loan fee is payable a split involves two or more separate facilities (accounts). Customers can elect to split their loan facility at time of application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Fixed rate lock fee
fees.info: A Fixed Rate Lock fee is payable to each fixed rate loan where the borrower has requested to have Fixed Rate Lock on their home loan application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Early Payout Cost (EPC)
fees.info: When you enter into a fixed rate loan contract, you are effectively locking in the loan interest rate offered to you for an agreed period of time (e.g. 5 years). If you decide to switch or payout your fixed rate loan before the end of your agreed period, you are effectively breaking that fixed rate loan agreement, an EPC that could cost you thousands of dollars may apply. Please refer to our ‘Early Payout Cost Factsheet’ for more information. Contracts entered into prior to 28 September 2021, the amount is referred to as an Early Payout Fee.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee
fees.info: Costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding debts vary depending on the nature of the default. These costs are applied by the Solicitors or independent contractors engaged to undertake action to recover the funds and are debited to the account that is "out of order".

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Security Adminstration Fee
fees.info: For each security offered to the Great Southern Bank loan. A securities administration fee applies to all secured credit facilities. The securities administration fee represents the average cost based on typical charges incurred in settling loans, including: • Progressive drawdowns • Bank cheque fee • Agent fee • Land title search • Credit reference fee • PPSR searches • PPSR charges

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge Fee
fees.info: If you pay out the loan partially or in full where a discharge of security is required, or you request a discharge of a security, a discharge fee is payable (per release or transaction).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee
fees.info: $200 minimum withdrawal applies in branch.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: If you request a title held by Great Southern Bank to be produced to a relevant state’s land titles office for any purpose, a production fee is payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee
fees.info: A variation fee is payable if you request any changes to the Credit Contract or Security - for example: - Re-arrange and/or substitute a security on a mortgage - Consent to any dealings in relation to property - Switch from one interest rate product to another, at the request of the borrower - Where a fixed interest rate has decreased between loan approval and loan funding, at the request of the borrower.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Government fees and charges
fees.info: Government fees and charges relating to stamp duty and registration are payable on an event causing a change or variation to the transaction and/or security being taken in the applicable state or territory. The amount of the fee will be subject to the relevant government scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. The amount of the fee will be subject to the Great Southern Bank panel valuers scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium
fees.info: Applicable only to eligible loans participating in the Home Guarantee Schemes including the First Home Guarantee (previously know as the First Home Loan Deposit Scheme), New Home Guarantee, Family Home Guarantee or Regional First Home Buyer Guarantee. If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee
fees.info: Costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding debts vary depending on the nature of the default. These costs are applied by the Solicitors or independent contractors engaged to undertake action to recover the funds and are debited to the account that is "out of order".

fees.label: UPFRONT

fees.label: EXIT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee
fees.info: $200 minimum withdrawal applies in branch.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: If you request a title held by Great Southern Bank to be produced to a relevant state’s land titles office for any purpose, a production fee is payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee
fees.info: A variation fee is payable if you request any changes to the Credit Contract or Security - for example: - Re-arrange and/or substitute a security on a mortgage - Consent to any dealings in relation to property - Switch from one interest rate product to another, at the request of the borrower - Where a fixed interest rate has decreased between loan approval and loan funding, at the request of the borrower.

fees.label: UPFRONT

fees.info: Government fees and charges relating to stamp duty and registration are payable on an event causing a change or variation to the transaction and/or security being taken in the applicable state or territory. fees.label: UPFRONT

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium

If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee
fees.info: Split loan fee is payable a split involves two or more separate facilities (accounts). Customers can elect to split their loan facility at time of application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee

fees.label: EXIT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee

fees.label: UPFRONT

fees.label: UPFRONT

fees.info: Account informaton fee is payable when customer request the following: - An annual audit certificate on a Great Southern Bank account - A copy of a cheque or Visa voucher - Personal information, traces, document copies (other than those specified above) and/or information pertaining to an account Where further investigation is required an additional hourly rate of $20 per hour will apply. An estimate of the costs involved will be provided prior to the work being undertaken.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: The establishment fee for non Rate Breaker home loans covers the cost of one valuation. A valuation fee may be payable in the future if Great Southern Bank considers it necessary to revalue the property at any time. The amount of the fee will be subject to the Great Southern Bank panel valuers scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Home Guarantee Scheme LMI Premium
fees.info: Applicable only to eligible loans participating in the Home Guarantee Schemes including the First Home Guarantee (previously know as the First Home Loan Deposit Scheme), New Home Guarantee, Family Home Guarantee or Regional First Home Buyer Guarantee. If the Guarantee Certificate expires or is otherwise discharged due to an act or omission undertaken by you or a guarantor, Great Southern Bank may seek to obtain lenders’ mortgage insurance (LMI) in respect of the Loan and in that case, you must pay this fee to reimburse Great Southern Bank for the cost incurred in obtaining LMI. For Contracts entered into prior to 22 June 2022, the applicable premium amount is referred to as a FHLDS LMI Premium or Family Home Guarantee LMI Premium.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Arrears Letter Fee
fees.info: Payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a letter in relation to arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Default notice fee is payable where Great Southern Bank sends you a default notice in relation to outstanding arrears on your account.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Top-Up establishment fee
fees.info: Top-up establishment fee applies for a further advance on a loan and includes the cost of processing the application and the preparation of the Great Southern Bank loan documentation.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Split Loan Fee
fees.info: Split loan fee is payable a split involves two or more separate facilities (accounts). Customers can elect to split their loan facility at time of application.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Debt Collection Fee
fees.info: Costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding debts vary depending on the nature of the default. These costs are applied by the Solicitors or independent contractors engaged to undertake action to recover the funds and are debited to the account that is "out of order".

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Security Adminstration Fee
fees.info: For each security offered to the Great Southern Bank loan. A securities administration fee applies to all secured credit facilities. The securities administration fee represents the average cost based on typical charges incurred in settling loans, including: • Progressive drawdowns • Bank cheque fee • Agent fee • Land title search • Credit reference fee • PPSR searches • PPSR charges

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge Fee
fees.info: If you pay out the loan partially or in full where a discharge of security is required, or you request a discharge of a security, a discharge fee is payable (per release or transaction).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Redraw Fee
fees.info: $200 minimum withdrawal applies in branch.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: If you request a title held by Great Southern Bank to be produced to a relevant state’s land titles office for any purpose, a production fee is payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Re-documentation Fee
fees.info: Where a borrower requests, and Great Southern Bank agrees, to a restructure of a loan between approval and funding and that change requires amended documentation to be prepared, a fee will be payable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation Fee
fees.info: A variation fee is payable if you request any changes to the Credit Contract or Security - for example: - Re-arrange and/or substitute a security on a mortgage - Consent to any dealings in relation to property - Switch from one interest rate product to another, at the request of the borrower - Where a fixed interest rate has decreased between loan approval and loan funding, at the request of the borrower.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Government fees and charges
fees.info: Government fees and charges relating to stamp duty and registration are payable on an event causing a change or variation to the transaction and/or security being taken in the applicable state or territory. The amount of the fee will be subject to the relevant government scale of fees current at that time.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Solicitors costs
fees.info: Solicitors costs are payable where they are engaged to prepare documents or provide advice relating to your matter on Great Southern Bank’s behalf.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Enjoy free redraw. Access your additional home loan repayments with redraw, so you can use it whenever you need some breathing space. A $200 minimum withdrawal amount applies for redraws conducted in-branch.

features.label: OFFSET
features.info: Offset your interest to save. Save on the amount of interest you pay and reduce your loan term by offsetting the combined balances of your Great Southern Bank everyday accounts with a free 100% Multi-Account Offset facility. You must maintain a minimum balance of $500 in each offset account to obtain the benefit of the offset from that account. Your offset account will not earn any interest.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: $0 Monthly or annual fees.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, Great Southern Bank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: A guarantor is someone who promises to repay money that is owed to us under a loan, if for some reason the borrower doesn’t.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: Reach your property goal sooner. Enjoy the flexibility of being able to make unlimited extra repayments without penalty.

eligibility.label: MAX_AGE
eligibility.info: Between 18 and 40 years of age

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: You must be an Australian citizen or Australian resident to hold an account with Great Southern Bank

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: A first home buyer (at least one applicant)

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: To be 18 or over

eligibility.label: NATURAL_PERSON
eligibility.info: Applications are for individuals and personal use purposes only.

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Minimum application amount of $100,000; or switching or restructuring of the home loan you already have with us when it includes new borrowing of at least $10,000.

constraints.label: MAX_LVR
constraints.info: Max LVR for Principal & Interest Owner Occupier Home Loan products is 95%

constraints.label: MIN_LVR
constraints.info: Min LVR for Home Loan products is 1%

fees.info: Payable when we consent to any subdivision, lease, discharge, partial discharge, change of name, release of a Security, changing a policy of lenders mortgage insurance, creation of subsequent Security Interest or any dealing in relation to a Security.

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Conversion fee - Switch to any other loan type
fees.info: $350 to convert, for example between a variable to a fixed loan or between principal & interest to interest only. If more than one loan is being converted at the same time each additional loan converted will attract a reduced fee of $250.

fees.info: Payable when we make a progress payment pursuant to your loan contract

fees.label: EVENT

fees.info: In default by an amount that is less than 2 repayments $20.00, otherwise $50.00.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Payable when we send you a notice informing you of a default under this contract

fees.label: EXIT

fees.info: A Discharge Administration fee is payable when you request us to close your loan account, or produce title deeds at settlement. If Greater Bank incurs any costs associated when doing this, the cost will also be passed on to you.

fees.label: WITHDRAWAL
fees.name: Redraw online banking fee
fees.info: Online redraw transactions do not attract a fee.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Establishment fee
fees.info: $500.00 based on one security plus $250.00 for each additional security. For each additional amount approved during the loan term, $350.00 based on one security plus $250.00 for each additional security.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Administration fee
fees.info: Payable when we consent to any subdivision, lease, discharge, partial discharge, change of name, release of a Security, changing a policy of lenders mortgage insurance, creation of subsequent Security Interest or any dealing in relation to a Security.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Break costs
fees.info: A break cost fee will be charged if we estimate we will make an economic loss as a result of the payout or a break from the fixed term

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Conversion fee - Switch to a Basic/Great Rate or Ultimate Home Loan
fees.info: $500 fee payable when you ask us to switch your loan to a Basic/Great Rate or Ultimate Home Loan. If more than one loan is being converted each additional loan converted at the same time will attract a reduced fee of $250.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Conversion fee - Switch to any other loan type
fees.info: $350 to convert, for example between a variable to a fixed loan or between principal & interest to interest only. If more than one loan is being converted at the same time each additional loan converted will attract a reduced fee of $250.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Administration Fee
fees.info: In default by an amount that is less than 2 repayments $20.00, otherwise $50.00.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Payable when we send you a notice informing you of a default under this contract

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge administration fee
fees.info: A Discharge Administration fee is payable when you request us to close your loan account, or produce title deeds at settlement. If Greater Bank incurs any costs associated when doing this, the cost will also be passed on to you.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Government charges
fees.info: Charges will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. These charges include Withholding Tax, Registration Fees on security documents and Stamp Duty. For Contracts Regulated by the National Credit Code, the only fees and charges that are payable are those set out in that contract (as varied from time to time).

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Guarantee fee
fees.info: Payable for each guarantee provided

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Law stationers fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when a third party agent acts for or otherwise assists us in relation to (including when we request information in respect of a security or any other matter in connection with) your contract with us or a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Legal fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when (or after) we make the amount of credit available to you for any costs and disbursements we have to pay a solicitor or conveyancer for acting for us in relation to this loan

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Mercantile agents fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when we instruct a mercantile agent to contact you on our behalf in relation to this loan or a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Mortgage insurance premium fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. The amount charged by our mortgage insurer for a lenders mortgage insurance policy.

fees.label: DEPOSIT
fees.name: Prepayment fee
fees.info: The prepayment fee is charged if we estimate we will make an economic loss as a result of extra repayments during a fixed rate term.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Registration fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when we register any documents in relation to a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Property Exchange Australia (PEXA) transaction fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when we have to register any documents in relation to a security using PEXA, request information using PEXA, or we process a financial settlement using PEXA. Fees are applied as charged by PEXA

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Settlement processing fee
fees.info: Payable for costs we incur in arranging settlement of the loan

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Title insurance premium
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. The amount charged by our title insurer for a lenders title insurance policy.

fees.info: $500 fee payable when you ask us to switch your loan to a Basic/Great Rate or Ultimate Home Loan. If more than one loan is being converted each additional loan converted at the same time will attract a reduced fee of $250.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Conversion fee - Switch to any other loan type
fees.info: $350 to convert, for example between a variable to a fixed loan or between principal & interest to interest only. If more than one loan is being converted at the same time each additional loan converted will attract a reduced fee of $250.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Administration Fee
fees.info: In default by an amount that is less than 2 repayments $20.00, otherwise $50.00.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Notice Fee
fees.info: Payable when we send you a notice informing you of a default under this contract

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge administration fee
fees.info: A Discharge Administration fee is payable when you request us to close your loan account, or produce title deeds at settlement. If Greater Bank incurs any costs associated when doing this, the cost will also be passed on to you.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Government charges
fees.info: Charges will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. These charges include Withholding Tax, Registration Fees on security documents and Stamp Duty. For Contracts Regulated by the National Credit Code, the only fees and charges that are payable are those set out in that contract (as varied from time to time).

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Guarantee fee
fees.info: Payable for each guarantee provided

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Law stationers fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when a third party agent acts for or otherwise assists us in relation to (including when we request information in respect of a security or any other matter in connection with) your contract with us or a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Legal fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when (or after) we make the amount of credit available to you for any costs and disbursements we have to pay a solicitor or conveyancer for acting for us in relation to this loan

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Mercantile agents fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when we instruct a mercantile agent to contact you on our behalf in relation to this loan or a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Mortgage insurance premium fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. The amount charged by our mortgage insurer for a lenders mortgage insurance policy.

fees.label: DEPOSIT
fees.name: Prepayment fee
fees.info: The prepayment fee is charged if we estimate we will make an economic loss as a result of extra repayments during a fixed rate term.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Registration fee
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. Payable when we register any documents in relation to a security.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Property Exchange Australia (PEXA) transaction fee
