fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Settlement processing fee
fees.info: Payable for costs we incur in arranging settlement of the loan

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Title insurance premium
fees.info: Fee amount will be variable, calculated if and when applicable. The amount charged by our title insurer for a lenders title insurance policy.

fees.label: EVENT

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: TITLESEARCH
fees.info: Payable when you undertake a title search in relation to any security

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: SETTLEMENTATTFEE
fees.info: Payable when we are required to attend any settlement on your behalf

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: SEARCHFEE
fees.info: Payable when we undertake any search in relation to your company or business at ASIC

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: PROGPAYMENT
fees.info: Payable on the 8th and any subsequent drawdown on a construction loan

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: PHOTOCOPYFEE
fees.info: $3 per page. Payable when you ask us to photocopy documents for you

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: DISCHARGE_FEE
fees.info: Payable when any security is wholly or partially discharged.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: REDRAW
fees.info: Payable each time you request a redraw on your loan over the counter. For all loans apart from Interest Saver loans, this fee is waived for the first redraw requested each month. This fee does not apply if your request is processed via iBank

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: CONSENT_FEE
fees.info: Payable when you ask us to consent to a second mortgage on any security

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: DEFAULTFEE
fees.info: Payable on the last day of each month during which there is an amount overdue for payment on your loan.

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: AGENT_FEE
fees.info: Payable if we need to instruct an agent in connection with the settlement of your loan

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: CHQFEE
fees.info: Payable for each cheque required on settlement in excess of five (5) cheques

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: DUPLICATESTATEMENTFEE
fees.info: Duplicate Statement Fee - $2 per page of statement produced. Payable when you ask us to produce duplicate statements for you.

fees.label: CASH_ADVANCE
fees.name: LANDTITLE
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable when you request us to produce a title deed

fees.label: CASH_ADVANCE
fees.name: LEGALCOSTS
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable when we pay our solicitors as a result of your application for a variabtion to, discharge of or our consent to any variation of your agreement or security

fees.label: CASH_ADVANCE
fees.name: SECURITYSEARCH
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable if we need to search a register in relation to any security

fees.label: CASH_ADVANCE
fees.name: VALFEE
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable when we have to pay a valuer as a result of your application for our consent to any matter relating to this agreement or the security, a variation of the agreement or security, or for a progress payment under a construction loan

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: CONTRACTVARIATIONFEE
fees.info: Payable in the event we agree to vary your loan agreement

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: SWITCHFEE
fees.info: Payable when you convert from one interest rate option to another. This fee is in addition to any break costs payable

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: DISHONOURFEE
fees.info: Payable if a direct debit from another account to your loan is declined or a cheque deposited to your loan account is dishonoured

fees.name: Substitution in Security Fee
fees.info: Payable when the Security listed on a mortgage is changed. You may also be charged a valuation fee which is unascertainable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Conversion Fee
fees.info: May be payable when converting loan product type.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Dishonour (Direct Debit and Cheque)
fees.info: If you ask us to take a payment, either direct debit or salary deduction and you do not have enough funds in your account to cover this payment, you will be charged a fee.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Title Search Fee
fees.info: This comprises our external searcher’s fee and the Land and Property Information fees. (If the security involves a Community Scheme, or is outside New South Wales, or is old system title, this fee is unascertainable and may be higher. We may charge you what our solicitors or agents charge us to perform this search).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Consent Fee
fees.info: Payable whenever we agree to a change relating to the title of the property.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: International Transfer Inward
fees.info: Fee applies for the conversion of international transfers in a foreign currency to Australian dollars.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Premium Plus Administration Fee
fees.info: Annual package fee for Premium Plus Home Loan Package loans

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Electronic Transfer Fee
fees.info: Payable to us when we are required to electronically transfer money for settlement.

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Document and Miscellaneous Service
fees.info: Fee applies if you request copies of documents such as withdrawal slips or statements, you ask us to verify a transaction on your account or you request any other information. It is calculated on an hourly basis, and charged to your account on a pro-rata basis (subject to minimum charges applying) after the search is undertaken. $60/hour (min $10/copy).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Administration Fee 1
fees.info: Where one payment or less is in arrears at the end of the month.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Reschedule Fee
fees.info: Payable to us when your discharge settlement is cancelled and/or rescheduled. This fee is payable in either cash or cheque at the time of settlement.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Default Administration Fee 2
fees.info: Where more than one repayment is in default (the fee will be charged the month the payment is due and each later month until the month after you pay the amount).

fees.label: VARIABLE
fees.name: Break Costs Fixed Rate Loans
fees.info: Are payable when before the end of the fixed rate period the borrower “breaks” the fixed rate by: repaying all of the amount owing; or repaying early more than $25,000 during any calendar year; or switching to another product, interest rate or payment type; or are in default and the total amount owing becomes immediately due for payment.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Cheque Fee NPBS Cheque only
fees.info: Payable to us when we are required to issue Financial Institution Cheques for settlement. Financial Institution Cheque means a cheque which is issued by us and drawn on us. Where the settlement cheque is drawn by a third party, the fee charged to us by the third party will be passed on to you. The amount of these third party fees may vary and are unascertainable as at the date of these terms and conditions.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Rate Lock Fee
fees.info: This fee is charged for each loan account for which you've opted to lock in a rate, and for each instance of locking in a rate. We charge the Rate Lock Fee to your loan account on the day the loan is funded. Refer to ‘Facts for Mortgage Loans’ for more information.

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge Administration Fee
fees.info: Payable whenever we arrange for a discharge of mortgage. There may also be fees charged by a third party.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Split Loan

features.label: CASHBACK_OFFER
features.info: Online Cashback Offer available on eligible purchased and refinanced loans for applications submitted through our online application channel. See Offer terms and conditions for details.

features.label: COMPLEMENTARY_PRODUCT_DISCOUNTS
features.value: Premium Plus Package: Packaged with a range of discounts and benefits available on other products including insurance discounts and fee discounts on other Newcastle Permanent loan products.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Redraw allowed, minimum withdrawal $500. Maximum amount of redraw limited to $25,000 per calendar year.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Our Rate Lock option enables you to lock in our current advertised interest rate for your selected fixed rate home loan product, giving you certainty for up to 90 days against potential interest rate increases. A non-refundable fee applies for selecting this option.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: You can make regular additional and extra lump sum repayments up to $25,000 per year. Break costs may apply if you make additional repayments of more than $25,000. See the Break Costs and Fixed Interest Guide for more info.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Additional Repayments allowed up to $25000 p.a.

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: Credit Approval. Applications for home loans are subject to the Bank's normal credit approval.

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: Must live in Australia and be either: an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or a New Zealand citizen

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Note that the credit limit we give you will depend on your ability to meet your repayments.

constraints.label: MAX_LVR
constraints.info: Maximum LVR for Interest Only loans.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Documentation Fee
fees.info: Payable in the following circumstances: preparation of an additional mortgage; preparation of a guarantee; or where documents have been cancelled or redone, at your request, after contracts have been issued.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Valuation Fee
fees.info: Valuation Fee at cost and payable by member.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Portability Fee

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI)

fees.name: Arrears Administration Fee 1

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Arrears Administration Fee 2
fees.info: Payable if you fail to make repayments due under your credit contract and your account remains in arrears for a period of 20 days or more.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Enforcement of Mortgage fee
fees.info: Charged whenever an enforcement notice is issued in relation to a credit contract that is secured by a mortgage over real property.

fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance Premium
fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: Bridging Loan is a short term loan (usually up to 12 months) that is closed when your existing property is sold. The size of the bridging loan is calculated on the available equity in your current home.There are two types of bridging loans - Closed bridging loans which is used if you already have a Contract of Sale on your current property and know the date when your home will be sold and the funds received. You'll pay down the loan plus any accrued interest and fees on this date. The other type of bridging loan is Open bridging loans which is used if your current home hasn't been sold yet. An open bridging loan can be arranged for up to 12 months.

fees.label: DISHONOUR

fees.info: A fee charged where a debit presented to us is dishonoured because there aren't enough available funds in your account.

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: Online international payment in foreign currency
fees.info: This fee is charged when you make an International Payment in foreign currency on-line via Internet banking or Bank Australia app. The cost is per transfer.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: International transaction fee (ITF)
fees.info: When you undertake an International transaction on a Bank Australia Visa Debit Card you will be charged the fee. An International transaction is any purchase, withdrawal or credit in a currency other than Australian Dollars or where the merchant or financial institution accepting the transaction is outside of Australia or where there is a currency conversion.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Monthly Fee
fees.info: A flat fee payable on the last day of each month.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Exceeding available funds fee
fees.info: A fee charged when you exceed the actual balance or authorised limit of your savings account, transaction account, or overdraft facility greater than $100 payable on the day the event occurs or next day.

fees.label: WITHDRAWAL
fees.name: Domestic ("press credit") cash withdrawal fee
fees.info: A fee that applies to any cash withdrawal transaction within Australia made using the "credit" option on a Bank Australia Visa Debit card.

fees.label: WITHDRAWAL
fees.name: Visa foreign cash withdrawal fee
fees.info: A fee that applies to any cash withdrawal transaction made with your Bank Australia Visa Debit Card outside Australia.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Staff assisted withdrawal fee
fees.info: A fee charged for taking money out of your account with the assistance of a staff member, charged on the day the service is provided.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Certificates supplied by the bank
fees.info: A fee for comprehensive certificates supplied for audit. The cost is $5 per page and $25 per hour.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Duplicate statement fee
fees.info: $5 per statement (for period more than 3 months before request). A fee that may be charged if you order a copy of a statement that has already been issued on your account. This fee per statement and is charged on or after the day you order the duplicate statement.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Dormancy Fee
fees.info: Administration fee where account has been transferred to dormancy status.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Security token fee
fees.info: When you request that we provide you with a physical Token to provide an additional layer of security when you engage in transactions that carry a higher risk. We do not charge for the virtual token.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: SMS alert fee
fees.info: This fee is charged when you elect to receive notifications about your account via SMS messages to a mobile telephone number you have given us for contacting you. The cost is per SMS.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Same day funds transfers within Australia fee (RTGS)
fees.info: This fee is for a Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) payment which refers to the process of transferring money from one bank to another in Australia on a real time and gross basis. The cost is per transfer.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Staff assisted international payment in foreign currency

fees.info: Visa International will convert all transactions made in foreign currency or processed overseas on the Visa Debit Card into Australian dollars at the foreign exchange rate that applies on the day the transaction is processed by Visa International. A Foreign Currency Conversion fee is payable for all of the following transactions made using your Visa Debit Card: » All transactions made overseas » All transactions in a currency other than Australian dollars » All transactions made in Australia where the merchant is located overseas » All transactions made in Australia where the financial institution or entity processing the transaction is located overseas. Transactions may not be processed to your account on the same day. To the extent permitted by law, you bear the risk of change in exchange rates in the intervening period. Refunds in currencies other than Australian dollars are converted to Australian dollars as at the date they are processed by Visa using exchange rates determined by them. This may lead to the refund being converted using an exchange rate different from the one used to convert the original purchase. The foreign currency conversion fee is not refundable as the fee is applied for facilitating the initial transaction.

fees.name: Sending Commercial Transaction

fees.info: Fees for receiving Commercial Transactions are taken from the total transaction amount.

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Receiving Fees for Registered Charities and Not-For-Profit Organisations
fees.value: Domestic Transactions: 1.1% + fixed fee; Cross-border Transactions: 2.1% + fixed fee. The fixed fee rates are contained in Clause 17.8 in the document link contained in additionalInfoUri field
fees.info: Registered Charities and Not-For-Profit organisations may apply for the following special rates for receiving PayPal Wallet Online Transactions

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Micropayment Pricing
fees.value: You can apply for the following micropayment fees. These fees apply to all Commercial Transactions you receive. If you have both a micropayment fees-enabled account and a standard pricing account, it is your responsibility to ensure payments are received to the appropriate account. Once a payment is received, you may not request it be processed through a different account. 5% + fixed fee (Domestic) and 6% + fixed fee (International)
fees.info: If you qualify as a seller for the micropayment pricing fees as set out in our User Agreement, you will pay the lesser of the: Micropayment pricing fees 5% + fixed fee (Domestic) - 5.5% + fixed fee (International) OR Fees described in the 'Receiving Commercial Transactions' Fee

fees.label: TRANSACTION
fees.name: Australia Fixed Fee
fees.value: $0.30 AUD (Personal Transaction fixed fee), $0.30 AUD (Commercial Transaction fixed fee), $0.05 AUD (Micropayments fixed fee)
fees.info: Fixed fees are based on the currency received and transaction type. These fees are based on AUD as the currency received - for other country currency fees, see section 17.8 in the T&C link provided in the additionalInfoUri field.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Currency Conversion Fees
fees.value: For some uses of your PayPal account, PayPal may determine currency conversion is necessary. For any of the following transactions that involve a currency conversion in connection with your PayPal account, the currency conversion fee is 4.0%: * Paying for goods or services in a currency other than the currency the goods or services are listed in. * Receiving a refund beyond 1 day of the original payment. * Sending money to a friend or family member such that they receive a different currency from the currency you pay in. * Sending money using PayPal’s Payouts (formerly Mass Pay) such that your recipients receive a different currency from the currency you pay in. * For all other PayPal transactions involving a currency conversion, the currency conversion fee is 3.0%.
fees.info: If PayPal converts currency, it will be completed at the transaction exchange rate we set for the relevant currency exchange. The transaction exchange rate is adjusted regularly and includes a currency conversion fee applied and retained by us on a base exchange rate to form the rate applicable to your conversion. The base exchange rate is based on rates within the wholesale currency markets on the conversion day or the prior business day; or, if required by law or regulation, set at the relevant government reference rate(s).

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Chargeback Fee
fees.info: Chargeback fees are based on the currency received. Chargeback fees do not apply if the transaction is eligible for the PayPal Seller Protection Policy.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Receiving eCheques
fees.info: Fees for receiving eCheque payments are based on payment currency and will not exceed the cap specified

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: PayPal Payouts (formerly Mass Pay)
fees.info: The fee for PayPal Payouts is 2% of the total payment amount. A maximum payment cap per recipient applies, based on payment currency.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Commercial Transaction Refund Fee
fees.value: The amount of the refunded payment will be deducted from your PayPal account
fees.info: If you issue a refund (partially or fully) of the Commercial Transaction payment, there are no fees to make the refund, but we will retain the full amount that you originally paid us. Your buyer’s account will be credited with the full or partial refund amount of the Commercial Transaction payment and your account will be debited with the full or partial refund amount

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Other - Expanded Use Fee
fees.value: The expanded use fee (verifying card details) can be up to $2 AUD.
fees.info: In general, there is no fee to open a PayPal account. However, we may charge an expanded use fee to increase your sending limit. This fee is refunded to your PayPal balance when you successfully complete the card verification process.

fees.label: ENQUIRY
fees.name: Other - Records Request Fee
fees.info: We will not charge for records requested in connection with your good faith assertion of an error in your account.

fees.label: WITHDRAWAL
fees.name: Other - Withdrawl Balance Fee
fees.value: Any conversion of your PayPal balance from one currency to another currency will attract the corresponding currency conversion fee in clause 17.10 of the T&C link provided in the additionalInfoUri
fees.info: The fee for withdrawing your balance to an eligible linked debit card or bank account is 1% of the amount transferred, with a minimum and maximum fee depending on the currency withdrawn. For AUD withdrawals: min AUD 0.25, max AUD 10.00. Minimum and maximum fees by currency are listed below where available.

fees.label: DEPOSIT

fees.label: PAYMENT
fees.name: Online international payment in foreign currency

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Term Deposit Early Withdrawal
fees.info: Any request for early release of funds from the term deposit will be subject to 31 days' notice. If regular access to funds is required, another account may be more suitable. The request for early withdrawal will incur an early release prepayment adjustment to the interest rate and a Term Deposit early withdrawal admin fee may apply. Please refer to Summary of Accounts for more information. Any funds you leave in the account will continue to earn interest at the interest rate originally agreed.
